definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + D-glucosamine(out) = protein histidine + glucosamine-6-phosphate(in).
label: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-D-glucosamine phosphotransferase system transporter activity
